newsitem.title: TURKEY: Bosphorus closed to northbound traffic due to fog.
newsitem.headline: Bosphorus closed to northbound traffic due to fog.

text.p: The narrow Bosphorus waterway was closed to northbound traffic since early morning due to fog over Istanbul, maritime officials said on Tuesday.
They added that only passenger ships were allowed to navigate to the south. "The fog has been hampering the traffic since 5 a.m. (0300 GMT)," said one official.
"But we hope the weather will clear pretty soon," he said.
He said only passenger ships less than 100 metres (yards) long which have high quality radar systems were allowed to sail south.
Several cargo vessels and other ships were kept off the south and north ends of the strait, he said.
